in_latin.name: Evangelinus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Evangelinus significat adventum Christi per evangelium, quod est verbum Dei, per quod homo salus fit. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Evangelinus significat messianicam adventum, qui est Christus, qui est Deus et homo.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Evangelinos' is derived from the Greek word 'evangelion', meaning 'good news' or 'gospel'. The name became popular among Christians during the early Christian period, particularly during the time of the Apostles and the early Church Fathers. It was given to those who spread the gospel message, often as a form of recognition for their dedication and service.

During the Byzantine Empire, the name 'Evangelinos' was also given to those who were involved in the copying and preservation of ancient Greek manuscripts, including the Christian scriptures. These individuals were often monks or scribes who dedicated their lives to the preservation and study of the sacred texts.
